page.overview:
Who is Clock Bear?

Clock Bear is a hybrid bear creature that first appears in Finn's dream in "Hoots." He later appears in "Preboot" as one of Dr. Gross' many Hybrid Animals. His first major appearance is in "The First Investigation". After escaping Dr. Gross' lab, Clock Bear made his way to Joshua and Margaret old office. Kim Kil Whan's employee, Rennie Hamlin discovered ghosts and haunting at the office. Kim Kil Whan then asked Finn and Jake to investigate. The ghosts turn out to be timeslips. Time slips are replays of things that happened in the past in that area. These time slips were caused by Clock Bear feeling sick. Finn however, turned his wind-up switch, removing all the time ghosts.
